title: Harvest
setupHelp: Create a personal access token at id.getharvest.com/developers. Enter its account ID and token here, not in chat. Credentials are saved locally with owner-only permissions.
noProjects: No assigned projects found. Check your Harvest project assignments.
error.auth: Harvest rejected your credentials or permissions.
error.credentials: Enter a valid account ID and personal access token.
error.permissions: Credentials file must have owner-only permissions, chmod 600.
error.network: Could not reach Harvest. If you changed a timer, refresh before retrying.
error.timeout: Harvest timed out. Refresh before retrying a timer change.
error.rate: Harvest rate limit reached. Wait a minute, then refresh.
error.rejected: Harvest rejected this change. Refresh and check whether the entry is locked.
error.running: A timer is already running. Stop it first, then refresh.
error.invalid: Invalid selection. Refresh and select a project and task again.
error.response: Could not read Harvest data or local settings.
